name: Startup MVP
description: Move fast without setting fire to the future: lighter gates, economics on, heavy process off.
notes: Enforcement is 'warn', not 'off': destructive Bash commands prompt instead of being denied, and a write containing a secret is still denied outright at every level except 'off'.

The completion-verification gate and the subagent context firewall are governed by their own settings, not by the enforcement level, so they stay on here — shipping something believed to work but never run is the most expensive startup habit.
